subject: SSO/SCIM: min-priv delegation analysis + SAML/SCIM artifacts for NovaTech
messages:
From: Lina Gomez <security@novatech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Peter Smythe <peter.smythe@novatech.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SAML assertions + SCIM delta for min-priv review

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG/SOC2 intake, we need a short package focused on how NovaTech identities are provisioned and scoped for the Redwood integration. Specifically we need: 

- A set of 3 recent SAML assertion samples (redacted acceptable) covering typical login flows for admin and end-user roles.
- A SCIM delta export showing role assignments / group changes for the last 30 days.
- RBAC owner mapping (who is owner for each role) and any documented delegation rules.
- A short note (one paragraph) on how you enforce least-privilege for service accounts and delegated admin.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these by EOD Wednesday (2026-10-14)? Also let us know if you prefer to put artifacts in a shared Drive folder or upload to HubSpot.

Thanks,
Lina
Security Operations
NovaTech Labs

Attachments: none

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Lina Gomez <security@novatech.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Peter Smythe <peter.smythe@novatech.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML assertions + SCIM delta for min-priv review

Lina — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver the package; outline and proposed delivery below.

Planned deliverables (target: 2026-10-14 17:00 PT):
- saml_assertion_samples.xml (3 files): one admin sign-in, one service-account assertion, one end-user assertion. We will redact PII (NameID/email) unless you require full assertions for signature verification.
- scim_delta_202609.csv: SCIM deltas for 2026-09-12 through 2026-10-12 with ops-type (add/update/delete), actor, timestamp, and role attribute changes.
- rbac_owner_matrix_v2.xlsx: owner column, role definition, least-priv rationale, last reviewed date.
- minpriv_delegation_timeline.pdf: short narrative + timeline of delegation changes (requested/approved) for the last 6 months.

Clarifying Qs:
1) Redaction: Confirm whether redacted NameIDs are acceptable for your auditors, or do you need the full values for signature/hash comparison?
2) Delivery: We can upload to your Drive folder if you share it, or we can post to the HubSpot record you referenced. Which do you prefer?

Internal: Irene / Soojin — can you assemble the SCIM delta and the RBAC matrix; I will pull the SAML assertion samples and draft the timeline. Aim to package as ZIP and upload to the Drive link or HubSpot.

Marcus Lin
Senior Product Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments (to come): saml_assertion_samples.xml (stub), scim_delta_202609.csv (stub), rbac_owner_matrix_v2.xlsx (stub)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML assertions + SCIM delta for min-priv review

Marcus / Soojin — prepping artifacts now. Notes for packaging:

- SCIM delta: will include columns: timestamp, op (add/update/delete), user_id, actor_id, groups_before, groups_after, role_attribute. We'll filter system noise and include only role/group changes relevant to NovaTech integration.
- RBAC owner matrix: pulling role-owner link from the ownership table; if owner is a team, will include primary contact.
- SAML samples: security asked for three samples. For the service-account assertion, we'll redact subject/NameID but include full assertion body and the AuthnStatement timestamps and Audience/Issuer so they can validate flow.

Timeline:
- 2026-10-12 EOD: internal package draft (I will attach interim CSV/Excel).
- 2026-10-13 11:00 PT: internal review and redaction pass.
- 2026-10-13 14:00 PT: package delivered to Drive / HubSpot per Lina's preference.

Soojin — you own the RBAC matrix. Please mark any roles that are delegated (iam:delegated=true) and add the last_approval column.

Irene
Security Compliance, Redwood

Attachments (internal drafts): scim_delta_202609_draft.csv, rbac_owner_matrix_v2_draft.xlsx

From: Peter Smythe <peter.smythe@novatech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lina Gomez <security@novatech.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML assertions + SCIM delta for min-priv review

Team — thank you, this is perfect. Lina confirmed redacted NameIDs are fine for our auditors as long as the assertion signature and timestamps are intact. Please upload to the shared Drive folder below (Lina will add us if needed):
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-novatech-sso-evidence

A couple of tiny asks for the package:
- In the RBAC matrix, please add a boolean column "delegated_admin" and a short justification where delegation exists.
- In the SCIM delta CSV, include actor_email when available so we can reconcile approvers.

If you can get this into the Drive by 2026-10-13 16:00 PT we will mark the intake as complete and attach to the SIG entry.

Best,
Peter
Director, IT Security
NovaTech Labs

> Marcus
